about: CI cost manifest (ci-spend law, 2026-10-11). One entry per workflow, one leg per runner OS. scripts/check_workflow_runner_cost.py fails a workflow or OS leg without an entry, an entry without a benefit, triggers/crons/jobs that differ from the workflow file, $ that do not add up, a repo total over repo_share_usd, and (locally, with sibling repos beside it) a sum over the weekly ceiling.
prices_source: GitHub billing API pricePerUnit (Actions Linux / Windows / macOS 3-core), read 2026-10-11

update-version.yml.benefit: Records the app version after a deploy.
